name: Pexip Holding ASA
summary: Pexip Holding ASA, a video technology company, offers end-to-end video conferencing platform and digital infrastructure in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It provides self-hosted software application and as-a-service deployment options for enterprise video conferencing, built on its proprietary Infinity technology.
